tool_args.rationale: Fit the four parameters of the verified barrier-activated siphon numerically and submit it for fresh confirmation. The pilot gradients are subcritical and sufficiently varied, so no additional probe is indicated.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed gradient span is 2.0, well above the stated 0.08 ambiguity threshold.
The authorized mechanism specifies a snapshot law with four parameters, and five pilot observations are available.
These do not incorporate the observed barrier-modulated sink dependence specified by the jointly matched mechanism.
